svg.title: Information, targets, law, action and loss

cc:Work.dc:title: Information, targets, law, action and loss
cc:Work.dc:description: Information and producer model/computation point to selection beliefs. Beliefs and targets/loss/constraints point to a feasible grade. The grade and target state point to realized loss, then to conditional risk. A dashed arrow from the declared evaluation law specifies averaging. The mobile layout stacks the same dependencies.
